correctness.rationale: An–Drummond-Cole–Knudsen 2019 Theorem 4.5 and Proposition 4.9 give the integral comparison. The self-contained verifier computes an exact 16524-by-6528 top differential, a mod-101 rank lower bound 6521, and seven integral zero-boundary vectors with identity free-coordinate matrix. This proves integral H3 has rank seven with a canonical integral basis. The action of each of 216 exhaustive graph automorphisms is checked via integral chain equality; the 13 class traces, kernel order three, square norm three, and exact rational central eigenspace ranks 1,2,4 follow.
